[[Image:EltdownShards.png|right|160px]]
'''Eltdown Shards''' is a [[unique item]].  It first appeared in the [[Kingsport Horror]] expansion.

==Card info==
'''Type''': [[Tome]]

'''Movement''': Exhaust and spend 2 [[movement]] points to make a [[Lore check|Lore (-2) check]].  If you pass, remove one [[doom token]] from the [[doom track]], discard Eltdown Shards and lose 2 [[Sanity]].  If you fail, nothing happens.

'''Price''': $5
